Note:
Calling
ara::log::LogStream::Flush
is only necessary if the
ara::log::
LogStream
object is going to be re-used within the same scope. Otherwise, if the
object goes out of scope (e.g. end of function block) then the flushing operation will
be done internally by the destructor. It is important to note that the
ara::log::
LogStream::Flush
command does not empty the buffer, but it forwards the buffer's
current contents to the
Logging framework
.
